summary: The interface delivers a coherent dark-themed RTL recording studio layout, but exhibits minor RTL key-ordering issues in shortcut badges and reversed transcript metadata placement.

issues.title: Inverted shortcut modifier order in RTL
issues.description: Modifier keys appear after trigger keys inside shortcut badges rather than preceding them.
issues.evidence: Search bar displays 'K Ctrl' instead of 'Ctrl K'; bottom action displays 'S ⌘' instead of '⌘ S'.
issues.suggestion: Ensure shortcut container retains LTR ordering for key combinations in RTL contexts.

issues.title: Transcript timestamp placement misaligned with text flow
issues.description: Timestamps appear at the trailing end of Hebrew text lines instead of anchoring to a consistent start margin.
issues.evidence: Transcript timestamps (00:00, 00:07) are positioned to the left of the Hebrew sentences rather than in a dedicated leading column on the right.
issues.suggestion: Move timestamps to a fixed right-hand gutter preceding the transcript text.
